skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of real estate business and management, including market analysis, business planning, production management, and human resource management.
Analyze business opportunities and establish real estate businesses.
Manage real estate production and sales.
Manage human resources in real estate business.
Analyze and forecast business environment, develop strategic plans for real estate business.
Understand legal regulations related to real estate business.
Identify and evaluate business opportunities, choose appropriate business models.
Work effectively in teams to solve real estate business problems.
Analyze and evaluate real estate business opportunities and strategies.
